name: Bearing near the Rule 13/15 boundary, wavering aspect
description: Target approaching at a bearing right at the 112.5 deg overtaking/crossing boundary, and its own heading wavers slightly over time (simulating yaw), flipping the encounter classification back and forth for a step-by-step oracle. Correct: Rule 13(c) -- when in doubt, assume overtaking (the more conservative obligation).
pass_criteria: Own-ship's rule citation stays consistent (does not flip every step).
